title: Saga 2 Chapter 29 — The Sedoner Boner / Mushroom Strip
summary: A back-to-back 2015 recording that never reaches the promised Trial of Poon. It opens with damaged Mangchi music, documents microphone-capacity exclusion and a failed pre-roll capture, then moves through Hawaii, private clinical retellings, a pseudonymous date, Stevie's sobriety boundary, a long Sedona mushroom narrative, an unexpected visitor's escalating unwanted contact, UFC 182, an aborted revenge-sex encounter, trivia and an embedded song. The source remains uncensored. The editorial layer keeps live speech, folklore, medical hearsay, reenactment, hallucinated perception, recorded/public/private images, deliberate wrong trivia answers and music distinct. Pseudonyms stay unresolved; intimate visitors and partners stay anonymous; medical labels and drug experiences remain self-report; repeated unwanted contact remains literal without inferring the absent person's sexuality or intent. Search must return surrounding correction/counterpoint, especially 'attacked' immediately retracted to 'made out,' kissing explicitly rejected as entitlement to sex, and a participant saying she feels bad before contact stops.

speaker_policy.reason: No validated named turns or held-out identity windows exist. The episode contains overlap, reenactments, pseudonyms, embedded music and nonliteral intoxication accounts.

source_notes.claim: Sex addiction is not real and is only a problem if the person believes it is.
source_notes.assessment: This is reported clinician speech. ICD-11 recognizes compulsive sexual behaviour disorder, while this recording cannot diagnose anyone.

source_notes.claim: A fixed abstinence period scientifically resets brain chemistry.
source_notes.assessment: The episode relays a treatment-center analogy without evidence for a universal fixed reset. Treatment should be individualized.

source_notes.claim: Psilocybin mushrooms were legal to buy or personally use in Arizona.
source_notes.assessment: At the recording date recreational possession/use was not generally legal; the cast's buy-versus-sell distinction is not reliable legal advice.

source_notes.claim: The trip revealed literal astral planes, civilizations and alien transmissions.
source_notes.assessment: The narrator explicitly describes mushroom hallucinations. Archive them as subjective perception, not external events.

source_notes.claim: Jon Jones fought Daniel Cormier and Donald Cerrone fought Myles Jury.
source_notes.assessment: These are UFC 182 event facts and can anchor the January 3, 2015 trip chronology.

source_notes.claim: The age of consent in Hawaii is 16.
source_notes.assessment: The remark is used as a taunt and does not establish legality in any particular situation; age-gap and authority laws vary and ethical consent is broader than a minimum age.
